:::{#def-power}
#### Power

Let $a$ be a real number and $n$ a
[natural number](notation.qmd#def-natural-numbers).
The $n$th **power** of $a$ is the product of $n$ copies of $a$:

$$a^n \eqdef \underbrace{a \cd a \cd \cdots \cd a}_{n \text{ factors}}$$

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-power-base}
#### Base of a power

In $a^n$ (@def-power), $a$ is the **base**.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-power-exponent}
#### Exponent of a power

In $a^n$ (@def-power), $n$ is the **exponent**.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-square}
#### Square

The second power $a^2$ (@def-power) is the **square** of $a$.

:::
